changes_made.explanation: Removed all metadata as the paper does not use LLMs as judges. These models are used as scoring components in the n-best reranking system, not as post-generation evaluators.
Paper relies solely on automatic metrics (BLEU, chrF, COMET22) with no mention of human evaluation.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The main issue was with Question 3 where models used as scoring components in the n-best reranking system were incorrectly interpreted as LLM judges. The paper focuses on knowledge distillation for machine translation using diverse scoring models to select optimal pseudo-labels from n-best lists, with evaluation via standard automatic metrics.
